slides.title:
islamic ways to
cool your anger
slides.sub:
From the Qur'an & Sunnah, for the moment
before you say something you regret

diagram.js: P.grid(W*0.12,0,W*0.76,H,{step:26}); const c=['#c0532d','#2f5c9e','#1f7a72']; const x=W*0.5, top=H*0.08, bot=H*0.78; P.rect(x-28,top,56,bot-top,{c:T.ink,w:4}); P.circle(x,bot+40,110,{c:T.ink,w:4,fill:c[0]}); P.rect(x-16,top+60,32,bot-top-50,{c:'none',hatch:c[0],gap:7}); [['boiling',0.12],['heated',0.38],['calm',0.7]].forEach(([t,f],i)=>{const y=top+(bot-top)*f; P.line(x+28,y,x+52,y,{c:T.ink,w:3}); P.text(x+70,y,t,{c:[c[0],'#d39a22',c[2]][i],size:30,anchor:'start'});}); P.arrow(x-90,top+40,x-90,bot-20,{c:c[2],w:3.4}); P.text(x-110,(top+bot)/2,'bring it\ndown',{c:c[2],size:28,anchor:'end'}); P.fig('speech',W*0.16,H*0.25,120,{c:T.ink,a:'#c0532d'}); P.fig('drop',W*0.86,H*0.68,90,{c:T.ink,a:'#2f5c9e'});

slides.title: #1 seek refuge out loud
slides.sub: Anger has a source. Name it.

quote.text: If he says: 'I seek refuge with Allah from Satan,' then all his anger will go away.

body: Two men were insulting each other, one red in the face. The Prophet ﷺ said he knew a word that would calm him.
Say it out loud: *a'udhu billahi min ash-shaytan ir-rajim.*

diagram.js: const c=['#c0532d','#2f5c9e','#1f7a72']; const x0=50,y0=H-40,top=30; P.grid(x0,top-10,W-x0,y0-top+10,{step:26}); P.arrow(x0,y0,x0,top,{c:T.ink,w:2.6}); P.arrow(x0,y0,W-10,y0,{c:T.ink,w:2.6}); P.text(x0+12,top+4,'anger',{c:T.ink,size:25,anchor:'start'}); const k=W*0.5; const a=[]; for(let x=x0+10;x<=k;x+=20){a.push([x,y0-20-Math.pow((x-x0)/(k-x0),1.6)*(y0-top-60)+Math.sin(x/14)*5])} P.curve(a,{c:c[0],w:4.5}); const b=[[k,top+40]]; for(let x=k+20;x<=W-40;x+=20){b.push([x,top+40+(y0-top-70)*(1-Math.exp(-(x-k)/90))])} P.curve(b,{c:c[2],w:4.5}); P.dot(k,top+40,18,{fill:c[1]}); P.text(k+16,top+6,"a'udhu billah",{c:c[1],size:27,anchor:'start'}); P.text(W-40,y0-80,'it settles',{c:c[2],size:26,anchor:'end'});

slides.title: #2 change your position
slides.sub: Your body can cool what your mind can't.

quote.text: When one of you becomes angry while standing, he should sit down. If the anger leaves him, well and good; otherwise he should lie down.

body: Standing? Sit. Still angry? Lie down.
Get lower, and the heat comes down with you.

diagram.js: P.grid(0,0,W,H,{step:26}); const c=['#c0532d','#d39a22','#1f7a72']; const L=[['person','standing',0.9],['sit','sitting',0.55],['lie','lying down',0.22]]; const bw=W*0.24; P.text(W/2,H*0.05,'how hot it gets',{c:T.ink,size:27}); L.forEach(([f,t,v],i)=>{const x=W*0.1+i*(bw+W*0.06), base=H*0.6, h=H*0.42*v; P.rect(x,base-h,bw,h,{c:c[i],hatch:c[i],w:3,gap:9}); P.fig(f,x+bw/2,base+80,bw*1.05,{c:T.ink,a:c[i]}); P.text(x+bw/2,base+160,t,{c:c[i],size:25});}); P.line(W*0.04,H*0.6,W*0.96,H*0.6,{c:T.ink,w:3});

slides.title: #3 redefine strong

quote.text: The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger.

body: The gym builds your body. This hadith shows where real strength is tested: the second you want to snap back.
